name: study-and-relax.ogg
title: File:Study And Relax by Kevin MacLeod.ogg
source: Wikimedia Commons. CC BY, not public domain - the artist's name has to travel with it, which is why it is written here and in the teacher plan.
usage: Thinking music while the 30-second clue timer runs, and the default track. Lofi: the artist describes it as a worn-out record with a mis-punched spindle hole, which is the warped-tape sound the genre is built on. Downloaded unedited; the widget only ever plays the opening 30 seconds and fades it out.

name: lift-motif.ogg
title: File:Kevin MacLeod - Lift Motif.ogg
source: Wikimedia Commons. CC BY, not public domain - keep the attribution.
usage: Thinking music while the clue timer runs, and the closest thing here to a quiz-show cue. Forty-four seconds of lift music: an ORIGINAL composition that does the job the television countdown does - polite, patient, faintly ridiculous - without reproducing the tune that does it, which is still in copyright. Downloaded unedited.
